summary: The note argues that soft skills such as communication, adaptability and emotional intelligence have become as important as technical hard skills in the job market since September 2023. It collects views from HR leaders, an economist, employers, educators, a career coach and a VR training firm, and cites a GET survey in which 78% of employers rate soft skills as equally or more important. It concludes that soft and hard skills complement each other and that investing in soft skills is essential for the future.
one_line: Since September 2023, employers, educators and trainers increasingly treat soft skills as equal to or more important than hard skills, complementing technical expertise.
key_facts: Discussion of soft skills has risen consistently since September 1, 2023, led by HR professionals, career experts and industry leaders.
Key soft skills named are communication, problem-solving, adaptability, creativity, teamwork and emotional intelligence.
Susan Ramirez, head of Hiring Strategies at FastTrack Solutions, said on October 12, 2023: "how you work is as important as what you work on."
Labor economist Jonathan Moore said in a November 8, 2023 webinar that automation and AI handle routine tasks, making human work more about interaction, ideation and emotional intelligence.
The Global Employment Trends (GET) panel surveyed over 1,000 employers worldwide in September and October 2023.
78% of surveyed employers believe soft skills are equally or more important than hard skills, mainly for collaboration in diverse, geographically dispersed teams.
Emily Wang, founder of the startup Connectech, says her best performers bring empathy to client interactions, lead by influence and navigate change deftly.
As of September 15, 2023, universities such as Midtown University introduced modules dedicated to developing soft skills.
Career coach Angela Robbins launched the "Soft Skills for Success" program on December 1, 2023, and saw overwhelming enrollment.
VRTraining Inc. builds virtual reality scenarios for practicing public speaking, negotiation and conflict resolution; CEO Alex Johnston introduced its latest product line on September 30, 2023.
Michael Spencer, Recruitment Director at TechCorp, said in a January 14, 2024 seminar that the interplay between hard and soft skills drives innovation.
Demand has spiked since September 2023 for roles needing strong soft skills, such as customer service representatives, salespersons, project managers and healthcare workers.
Professional development increasingly includes mentorship programs, leadership retreats and team-building exercises.
